name: dispatch-handoff-execution
objective: Close fail-closed dispatch mutation, offer/decision/reassignment and bilateral store-to-Captain custody with transactional, actor-isolated cross-surface truth.
truthOwner: DSH owns dispatch assignment, delivery lifecycle, custody and operational exceptions; WLT supplies bounded financial eligibility only and remains financial truth owner; surfaces issue authorized commands and render canonical readback.

tasks.objective: Close dispatch kill-switch, offer, decision, expiry and reassignment invariants
tasks.currentProblem: Dispatch is implemented-pending-verification and current mutation authority additionally requires an explicit fail-closed kill-switch configuration; same-candidate proof for bypass, concurrency, expiry and actor isolation is incomplete.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace every assignment mutation through decision service, eligibility, HTTP/domain/database and all readers; test missing/malformed/true/false kill-switch states and offer/accept/decline/expire/reassign adversarial cases; repair root cause and remove any bypass or duplicate mutation path.
tasks.targetState: No assignment mutation occurs unless runtime policy explicitly permits it and every DSH state precondition passes; one order has one legal active assignment and only the assigned Captain can decide within deadline.
tasks.action: Run dispatch/store/http/database checks; force kill-switch absent/malformed/killed/open cases; exercise duplicate idempotency, simultaneous assignment, late accept/decline, required decline reason, wrong Captain/context and reassignment; verify operator/client readback then clean obsolete bypass logic.
mustNotChange: Do not default a missing/malformed kill switch to open.
Do not bypass complete U003 eligibility at final assignment.
Do not permit late decision, competing active assignments or caller-controlled Captain identity.
Do not expose internal eligibility/decision details to app-client.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/malformed/nil/unsupported dispatch decision configuration fails closed and explicit killed state blocks assignment.
Explicit permitted state still requires all DSH eligibility/order/service-area/idempotency/state preconditions.
Accept/decline is assigned-Captain-only, deadline-bound and decline-reason guarded.
Concurrent create/reassign cannot create two legal active assignments for one order or exceed Captain capacity.
Operator and client canonical readbacks agree with DSH state using role-appropriate fields.
No known bypass, duplicate mutation path or stale assignment branch remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused dispatch fix while preserving fail-closed decision configuration and transactional assignment invariants; never reopen dispatch by default.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused dispatch policy/state-machine commit after negative and concurrency checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close bilateral custody, exception blocking, replay and supersession end to end
tasks.currentProblem: Product Truth requires partner confirmation plus Captain completion before pickup, durable blocking exceptions, replay identity protection and supersession on reassignment; static wiring is not same-candidate proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace arrival/custody creation, partner release, Captain pickup, shortage/mismatch, operator resolution, supersession and client readback through DSH persistence/contracts; repair every illegal/local/non-idempotent transition and remove obsolete parallel custody behavior.
tasks.targetState: Pickup is impossible before legal bilateral custody; blocking exception/supersession survives refresh and only governed resolution/current assignment can permit continuation.
tasks.action: Exercise successful bilateral flow plus Captain-before-partner pickup, cross-store partner confirm, repeated commands, payload drift, open exception, operator resolution, reassignment supersession and refresh/restart; verify all affected surfaces and database audit/state.
mustNotChange: Do not mark pickup from local UI state.
Do not allow a superseded assignment/custody attempt to remain executable.
Do not accept replay payload drift under the same mutation identity.
Do not mutate WLT from custody/exception resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner and Captain custody confirmations are independently authorized, audited and duplicate-safe.
Illegal pickup before bilateral completion or while a blocking exception is open is rejected.
Reassignment supersedes prior custody and cannot leave competing pickup paths.
Operator resolution and all surface refreshes read one persisted DSH exception/custody truth.
No known local-only, dead or duplicate custody path remains.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused custody/exception fix while preserving persisted history and legal pickup guards.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused handoff/custody commit separate from finance and support work.
